note: GFP state park at the foot of Bear Butte, a sacred site for many Plains tribes, 6 mi NE of Sturgis on SD-79. The campground is a gravel loop of back-in sites on open prairie above Bear Butte Lake, with the lake in view across marsh and scrub. Tent-only sites nearby and a separate horse camp west of the highway. Alcohol and uncased firearms are prohibited east of SD-79. --Claude
